cases.sentence: Ефремиты сказали Гидеону, «Почему ты так обошелся с нами? Почему ты не позвал нас, когда шел сражаться с ___?»
cases.translation: The men of Ephraim said to him, 'Why have you treated us this way, that you didn't call us when you went to fight with Midian?'
cases.explain: The preposition с (with) governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Разве виноград, который добирал Ефрем, не лучше, чем весь урожай моего клана, клана ___?
cases.translation: Isn't the gleaning of the grapes of Ephraim better than the vintage of Abiezer?
cases.explain: The possessive genitive indicates kinship and clan affiliation.

cases.sentence: Бог отдал ваши руки мадианских вождей Арива и ___.
cases.translation: God has delivered into your hand the princes of Midian, Oreb and Zeeb!
cases.explain: Possession after руки (hand) requires the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Он сказал жителям Суккота, «Дайте моим воинам хлеба, они утомлены, а я все еще преследую мадианских царей Зеваха и ___».
cases.translation: He said to the men of Succoth, 'Please give loaves of bread to the people who follow me; for they are faint, and I am pursuing after Zebah and Zalmunna.'
cases.explain: Names in a list with another name take genitive when used with the preposition.

cases.sentence: За это, когда Господь отдаст в мои руки Зеваха и Салмана, я растерзаю вашу плоть пустынным терновником и ___.
cases.translation: Therefore when Yahweh has delivered Zebah and Zalmunna into my hand, then I will tear your flesh with the thorns of the wilderness and with briers.
cases.explain: The preposition с (with) before the noun governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Гидеон сказал жителям Пинеэла, «Когда я вернусь с победой, я разрушу эту ___».
cases.translation: He spoke also to the men of Penuel, saying, 'When I come again in peace, I will break down this tower.'
cases.explain: The transitive verb разрушу (will break down) takes the accusative case for its direct object.

cases.sentence: Когда Гидеон, сын Иааша, вернулся с битвы при возвышенности Херес, он захватил юношу из Суккота, допросил его, и юноша написал ему имена правителей и старейшин ___.
cases.translation: Gideon the son of Joash returned from the battle. He caught a young man of the men of Succoth, and inquired of him; and he wrote for him the princes of Succoth.
cases.explain: The prepositional phrase of the city's rulers requires genitive for possession.

cases.sentence: Повернувшись к Иеферу, своему старшему сыну, он сказал, «Подойди и убей их, они убили моих братьев на ___».
cases.translation: He said to Jether his firstborn, 'Get up and kill them!' at Tabor.
cases.explain: The preposition на (on) with location governs the prepositional case.

reading.ru: Гидеон пришел и сказал жителям Суккота, «Вот Зевах и Салман, из-за которых вы издевались надо мной».
reading.question: What did Gideon say to the men of Succoth when he returned with Zebah and Zalmunna?
options: He reminded them how they had taunted him about the two kings
He thanked them for their help during the battle
He asked them to join his council
He invited them to celebrate his victory
reading.correct: He reminded them how they had taunted him about the two kings
reading.explain: Gideon pointed out the very kings about whom they had scoffed at him, saying he couldn't capture them.

reading.ru: Он взял старейшин города и преподал жителям Суккота урок, наказав их пустынным терновником и шиповником.
reading.question: How did Gideon punish the men of Succoth for refusing to help him?
options: He taught them a lesson with thorns of the wilderness and briers
reading.correct: He taught them a lesson with thorns of the wilderness and briers
reading.explain: The text states he took the elders of the city and with thorns and briers taught the men of Succoth a lesson.

reading.ru: После этого он спросил Зеваха и Салмана, «каковы были те, кого вы убили на Фаворе?» «Они были как ты», — ответили они, «каждый из них выглядел как царский сын».
reading.question: When Gideon asked about the men killed at Tabor, what did Zebah and Zalmunna say about them?
options: They said each man resembled the children of a king
They said they were simple farmers
They said they couldn't remember them
reading.correct: They said each man resembled the children of a king
reading.explain: The kings answered that the slain men looked like him, resembling the children of a king.

reading.ru: Гидеон сказал, «Это были мои братья, сыновья моей матери. Верно, как и то, что Господь жив. Если бы вы пощадили их, я сохранил бы вам жизнь».
reading.question: What was Gideon's relationship to the men killed at Tabor?
options: They were his brothers, his mother's sons
reading.correct: They were his brothers, his mother's sons
reading.explain: Gideon identified them as his own brothers, his mother's sons, and said he would have spared the kings had they spared them.

reading.ru: Израилетяне сказали Гидеону. «Правь нами, ты и твой сын, и твой внук, ведь ты спас нас от руки Модианитян».
reading.question: What did the Israelites ask Gideon to do after his victories?
options: They asked him to rule over them and establish a dynasty
They asked him to build a temple
They asked him to lead them to Egypt
They asked him to establish new laws
reading.correct: They asked him to rule over them and establish a dynasty
reading.explain: The men of Israel asked Gideon to rule over them, and his son and grandson after him, because he had saved them from Midian.

reading.ru: Гидеон сказал им, «Я не буду править вами, и мой сын не будет править вами. Править вами будет Господь».
reading.question: What was Gideon's response to the people's request?
options: He refused to rule, saying Yahweh would rule over them instead
He agreed to rule with his son
He appointed his grandson as king
He asked for time to consider their request
reading.correct: He refused to rule, saying Yahweh would rule over them instead
reading.explain: Gideon clearly stated he would not rule over Israel nor his son, but that Yahweh would be their ruler.
